name: io.github.ahmedmaaloul/synapse
description: Budgeted GraphRAG context (no second LLM bill), entity search and PDF ingestion on a Synapse graph.

environmentVariables.name: SYNAPSE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Synapse backend (FastAPI) the server talks to.

environmentVariables.name: SYNAPSE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional bearer token forwarded as Authorization: Bearer for an authenticating proxy in front of the backend.

environmentVariables.name: SYNAPSE_MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Default character budget for synapse_retrieve: 0 disables the budget, otherwise at least 200 (the backend's floor).

environmentVariables.name: SYNAPSE_CACHE_TTL
environmentVariables.description: Seconds identical retrievals are served from the in-process cache (0 disables).
